Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the medical vocabulary.
Arn.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the medical vocabulary.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 1011  
Pattern: arn:aws(-[^:]+)?:transcribe:[a-zA-Z0-9-]*:[0-9]{12}:[a-zA-Z-]*/[0-9a-zA-Z._-]+  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

VocabularyName.description: The name of the medical vocabulary.
VocabularyName.markdownDescription:
The name of the medical vocabulary.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 200  
Pattern: ^[0-9a-zA-Z._-]+$  
Update requires: Replacement

LanguageCode.description: The language code of the vocabulary entries.
LanguageCode.markdownDescription:
The language code of the vocabulary entries.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: af-ZA | ar-AE | ar-SA | da-DK | de-CH | de-DE | en-AB | en-AU | en-GB | en-IE | en-IN | en-US | en-WL | es-ES | es-US | fa-IR | fr-CA | fr-FR | he-IL | hi-IN | id-ID | it-IT | ja-JP | ko-KR | ms-MY | nl-NL | pt-BR | pt-PT | ru-RU | ta-IN | te-IN | tr-TR | zh-CN | zh-TW | th-TH | en-ZA | en-NZ | vi-VN | sv-SE  
Update requires: Replacement
